hook: Your artificial sun is real, and it burned for 1,066 seconds.
title: China Held an Artificial Sun for 1,066 Seconds
description:
China's EAST fusion reactor held superheated plasma for 1,066 seconds in January 2025. That is a record for this kind of reactor, and it is nicknamed the artificial sun. Fusion is the same process that powers the real Sun.

#Shorts #Fusion #Technology
comment_prompt: Could fusion power your home? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your artificial sun is real, and it burned for 1,066 seconds.
scenes.headline: ARTIFICIAL SUN

scenes.narration: China built it. It is called EAST.
scenes.headline: CHINA'S EAST REACTOR

scenes.narration: Inside, plasma gets hotter than the Sun's core.
scenes.headline: HOTTER THAN THE SUN

scenes.narration: So giant magnets hold it floating in air.
scenes.headline: HELD BY MAGNETS

scenes.narration: That is the same power that lights our Sun.
scenes.headline: POWER OF THE SUN

scenes.narration: It held that plasma for over seventeen minutes.
scenes.headline: OVER 17 MINUTES

scenes.narration: Your artificial sun is real, and it keeps getting longer.
scenes.headline: IT'S REAL
scenes.sub: Tomorrow: the biggest tides on Earth
